# The cJSON renderer on top-levels of every kind: a top-level that is not a
# named type gets a structure of its own (with a `value`), in the single
# header and in a file of its own with --source-style multi-source.
# Arrays of ints use the `deleteType === "cJSON_free"` branch, arrays of
# null the 0xDEADBEAF typo; nested arrays and maps are not supported.
